newsitem.title: USA: Comdial 1997 capital spending at $4 mln.
newsitem.headline: Comdial 1997 capital spending at $4 mln.

text.p: Comdial Corp's capital spending will likely reach $4 million in 1997, up from $3 million in 1995, the company's president said Tuesday.
"We have historically been between $3.0 million and $3.5 million," said President and Chief Executive Officer William Mustain in an interview.
He said the company planned to focus spending on modernizing equipment at its plant in Charlottesville, Va., and launching a new line of its digital telephone switching system, known as DXP.
He said the line was designed for medium-sized companies with up to 100 employees.
The company today reported higher 1996 fourth-quarter earnings and sales.
